Type:

Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint32_t> total_lines;
Description:
std::uint32_t optional member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined total_lines 16 bit
header field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype RVF.
The value range for total_lines shall be:
0x00 00 00 00 ... 0x00 00 FF FF : valid
0x00 01 00 00 ... 0xFF FF FF FF : not used
For transmission, the value of total_lines shall be set to the configured value, if it is not provided
the application.
Visibility:
protected
